FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & IT
BHADERWAH CAMPUS,
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
(“A+” Grade University Accredited by NAAC)
Walk-in-Interview for the Position of Project Fellow
Applications are invited on plain paper along with detailed CV for one post of Project Fellow
purely on temporary basis for the project sanctioned by “iHUB Divyasampark, IIT Roorkee
iHUB Divyasampark, Technology Innovation Hub (A joint initiative of DST Govt. of
India and IIT Roorkee)” under the “Divyasampark iHUB for Devices Materials and
Technology Foundation” scheme.
The details are as follows:
Name of Post: Project Fellow
Tenure of the Post: Till completion of the project subject to the satisfactory performance of
the candidate.
Eligibility Criteria: M.Sc. (Computer Science)/ MCA with atleast 60% marks or equivalent.
Consolidated Salary: Rs. 30000/-
The interested candidates should bring their detailed CV mentioning: telephone/mobile
number, e-mail address, qualification details, etc. along with the following documents at the
time of interview: - (1) Copy of CV indicating qualifications, experience, publications etc., (2)
Recent Photograph (3) Original copy of all the supporting documents (4) One complete set of
self-attested photocopies of relevant documents (5) Reprints of publications (if any) (6) Any
other supporting certificates (in original).
Date and venue of Walk-in-interview: 30th July 2024, 3 PM at the Department of Computer
Science & IT, University of Jammu.
NOTE: (1) The above post is purely temporary for the sanctioned project and duration (2) No
T.A/D.A. or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interview/joining (3)
Fellowship may be cancelled at any time in case of any misconduct, unsatisfactory research
work, and if fellow is found ineligible later.
Dr. Jatinder Manhas
(Project Coordinator)
Mobile: 9419173793, 8082770939
Email: manhas.jatinder@gmail.com
